floorRationale: The retired 127-package floor asserted the size of the whole managed runtime, which is no longer what ships inside the archive. The shipped base layer is the base profile plus its closure: 47 packages against the 387-entry lock at split time, and it cannot be a fixed list because the closure grows whenever a base dependency gains a dependency. The floor is therefore set below the known-good closure so it catches a truncated or unreadable lock, while exact membership is enforced by the closure walk, the residual-distribution check on the pruned archive, and the packer input being the pruned tree rather than the full staging runtime.
